TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD390B INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
535905N 0010306W (HUNTINGTON, YORK). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT
(BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL.
EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL 
DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT

CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE 
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR 
IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO
